_doc: HOW OFTEN THE HAND'S SHAPE CHANGES — three alternatives to look at (SW-88; RUNNING_LOG §293), drawn by tools/chord_changes.js on the workshop's pages 'chords: few / some / many'. page = the IR the notes are read from · window = the passage read (both hands) · view = what the page shows · headOpacity = the played notes, kept faint as his reference · spans = each alternative's ONE knob: how many semitones a hand may reach before its shape is written again.
